visual_action: A montage of clips highlighting achievements of the Biden administration. The video begins with Joe Biden in a suit and sunglasses walking towards the camera. It then cuts to a series of images and video clips with text overlays: Kamala Harris taking the oath of office, Joe Biden signing a bill at a desk, Joe Biden signing another bill outdoors surrounded by people, Joe Biden speaking at a podium, and Joe Biden walking with Ketanji Brown Jackson.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is shown in multiple clips throughout the video and is the subject of the text overlays detailing his administration's actions.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is shown taking the oath of office and is named in an on-screen text headline.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: She is shown walking with President Biden and is the subject of a headline about her Supreme Court nomination.

cast.name: Thomas R Carper
cast.evidence: He appears in the background crowd while Joe Biden signs the Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal.

cast.name: Thurgood Marshall
cast.evidence: He is mentioned in the on-screen text about Ketanji Brown Jackson's nomination to the Supreme Court.

on_screen_text.text: “What has changed since President Biden took office?”
Kamala Harris Becomes First Female Vice President in American History
Biden signs $1.9 trillion Covid relief bill
The new law marked the president’s first major legislative achievement since taking office.
Done deal: President Biden signs $1.2 trillion Bipartisan Infrastructure Deal into law
The Biden Boom: Economic Recovery in 2021
President Joe Biden took office one year ago amid one of the worst economies in generations, but the U.S. economy has since made tremendous progress toward recovery, and workers are benefiting.
Biden nominates Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court
Jackson would be the first Black woman on the high court, and the first justice since Thurgood Marshall with significant experience as a criminal defense attorney

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a popular song with lyrics, including the line "You know it's not the same as it was."
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat, popular pop song 'As It Was' by Harry Styles, creating an inspirational and positive tone that accompanies the montage of achievements.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage of different clips and still images, with text overlays appearing on screen to highlight specific events. The pacing is moderate, with cuts timed to the music.
central_claim: The Biden-Harris administration has brought significant positive change and achieved numerous historical milestones since taking office.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel proud of the Biden administration's accomplishments and to view the presidency as successful and transformative.
